description: This file defines the MainActivity for an Android app, which manages the display and interaction with a list of notes. It handles initializing the UI, loading notes from a database, and implementing search functionality.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing notes list UI and search functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, and prepares the notes list with click listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads notes from the database when the activity resumes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the database, optionally filtering by a search query, and updates the adapter.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and sets up the search functionality within the options menu.
